caption: Bread at Home has no PDF property. It embeds its PDF in the text, so its card uses that PDF.
eval: (async () => { app.plugins.plugins['pdf-cover-cards'].pro.signOut(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const leaf = app.workspace.getLeaf('split', 'vertical'); await leaf.openFile(app.vault.getFileByPath('PDF Cover Cards/Bread at Home.md')); window.__pccLeaf = leaf; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 900)); for (const v of app.plugins.plugins['pdf-cover-cards'].views) await v.fillAll(); const c = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pdf-cover-card')].find((x) => x.dataset.path.endsWith('Bread at Home.md')); c && c.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: every cover of the view on one PNG image with the titles, saved in the vault.
eval: (async () => { app.plugins.plugins['pdf-cover-cards'].pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('pdf-cover-cards-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await app.plugins.plugins['pdf-cover-cards'].pro.refreshNow(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800)); await app.plugins.plugins['pdf-cover-cards'].targetView()?.fillAll(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600)); const f = await app.plugins.plugins['pdf-cover-cards'].exportSheet(app.plugins.plugins['pdf-cover-cards'].targetView()); window.__pccSheet = f && f.path; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 900)); return 'ok'; })()
after: (async () => { const f = app.vault.getFileByPath(window.__pccSheet || ''); app.workspace.getLeaf(false).detach(); if (f) await app.vault.delete(f); app.plugins.plugins['pdf-cover-cards'].pro.signOut(); return 'ok'; })()
